The Australia-based fast-casual chain had operated in the region for six years. A class-action lawsuit was filed over claims the company failed to provide required employee notice.

The Melting Pot's Duluth location is closing on May 31, 2026, after a 36-year run in the community. The owners are hosting a "Final Dip Celebration Weekend" from May 29–31 with special dining experiences and commemorative keepsakes. Other chain locations in Roswell, Kennesaw, and Midtown Atlanta will continue operating.

Vilebrequin La Plage, a Riviera-inspired rooftop restaurant and poolside destination, has opened atop the UNFRAMED, Autograph Collection hotel in Miami Beach. The concept is a collaboration between 34th Floor, Schulte F&B Group, and French swimwear brand Vilebrequin, marking the brand's U.S. debut. It is the fifth global outpost of the luxury dining concept.

Uncle Fluffy opened its second Orange County location on May 23, 2026, at Triangle Square in Costa Mesa. The Japanese dessert cafe is known for its jiggly Japanese-style cheesecakes, and the new location will operate daily from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. The brand has been steadily expanding its California footprint.

slice/25, a new rooftop pizza-and-wine concept, debuted on May 21 atop Grand Hyatt Nashville's existing lou/na rooftop bar. The restaurant serves artisanal pizzas with curated wine pairings and offers walk-in service only during lou/na's regular hours. It provides views of the downtown Nashville skyline from the 25th floor.

A new Toastique location is set to open in Johns Creek this summer, operated by husband-and-wife team Steve and Randi Rubin. The menu will feature gourmet toasts, smoothies, superfood bowls, and cold-pressed juices. The site is located near schools and fitness studios.

Restaurateur Okan Ozyurteri is bringing Mozaika Mezze, a Mediterranean dining concept, to Buckhead this fall. The restaurant will feature Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese flavors with small-plate mezze and wood-grilled skewers. No address was provided in the article.

Bizarre Coffee Company is opening its fourth location in Downtown Acworth, which is currently under construction. The brand is known for specialty coffee and a community-driven atmosphere. No opening date or address was provided.

Phia, an Appalachian-inspired restaurant helmed by Chef Brad Feickert, is planned to open in August 2026 at 304 Carroll Street NW in the Takoma neighborhood of DC. The concept will occupy the former La Mano Coffee Bar space and will feature "Appalachian grassroots cuisine" with an Appalachian-sourced beverage program.

data.location: Between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road, Stafford County, VA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Buc-ee's has received approval from the Stafford County Board of Supervisors for a new 74,000-square-foot travel center location. The site will have 120 fuel pumps and over 800 parking spaces, though no opening timeline has been announced. The concept's application had been under review for over two years.

data.location: 5063 Wellington Road, Gainesville, VA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Honeygrow is preparing to open a new location at 5063 Wellington Road in Gainesville, Virginia, though no firm opening date has been announced. The Philadelphia-founded fast-casual chain offers customizable stir-fries and healthier options, and currently operates 76 locations across 8 states.

The Boston Licensing Board approved plans on May 7 for King Bee, a new restaurant and live music venue at 202 West First Street in South Boston. The project will convert three former industrial buildings into a hospitality and entertainment destination featuring a restaurant, cocktail bars, and live entertainment spaces. Developer Jack Bardy, also behind The Beehive, confirmed many details are still being finalized.

The Reserve Key West, a culinary collective housing multiple restaurant and cocktail concepts, has filed permit applications to open at 510 Southard Street in a converted bank building. The venue will include a rotating bar and a hidden speakeasy called The Vault inside the original bank vault. No specific opening date has been announced beyond "coming in 2026."

data.location: 500 W 7th St, Suite 175, Fort Worth, TX 76102
data.short_description: Almacen El Gallo, an elevated Mexican cuisine concept from Burciaga Hospitality Group, aims to open in mid-to-late June inside First on 7th, a former bank building in Fort Worth. The menu features grilled meats, barbacoa, moles, and stews, with branding inspired by La Lotería imagery. If successful, the concept may expand to Dallas, Frisco, or Houston.

Loaded Cafe is gearing up to open its 10th location at Civic Center Plaza in Norwalk, alongside its sister concept My Panecito. The Southern California chain launched in Long Beach in 2012 and offers a menu combining classic American dishes with Mexican flavors. An exact opening timeline has not been announced.

My Panecito, a panadería known for pastries such as conchas, will open its fifth location at Civic Center Plaza in Norwalk alongside sister concept Loaded Cafe. No exact opening date has been announced. The article notes What Now Los Angeles has reached out for more information.

data.location: 617 E Liberty St, Ann Arbor, MI 48104
data.status: planning to open in early August
data.short_description: Orijin Bakery, a new concept from The Pulpo Group's Sava Farah and pastry chef Jin Capobianco Gorian, is planned to open in early August at 617 E Liberty Street in downtown Ann Arbor. The bakery will serve pastries from The Boro alongside new savory breads. It is not yet confirmed whether coffee or tea will also be served.

Good God, Nadine's, a Houston bar and restaurant known for cocktails and Gulf Coast-inspired dishes, announced it will close on May 31, 2026, following the sale of its building. The establishment completed approximately one year in operation before the closure. The owners thanked staff and community in their Instagram announcement.

Pinnacle Brewing is planning to open a second Valley taproom and kitchen at 104 W. Main St. in Downtown Mesa in 2027. The family-owned brewery, which first debuted in Scottsdale in 2024, will occupy a space previously home to The Boutique. No further timeline details have been announced.

data.location: 9324 Clifford St, Suite 102, Fort Worth, TX 76108
data.short_description: Orange Leaf Yogurt will open a new location at Clifford Crossings in Fort Worth, with renovations expected to begin in June across a 1,279-square-foot space. The store will offer frozen yogurt, shakes, crepes, and a new ice cream sandwich product. This will be the 17th Orange Leaf location in Texas and the fourth in Fort Worth.

Gold Palm, an Oakland restaurant and cocktail bar founded in 2024, will serve its last dinner on May 27, 2026, citing financial challenges where the business was not generating enough revenue to sustain operations. The cocktail bar component, Moonglow, will remain open after the restaurant closes.

Crust Simply Italian's planned Mesa location at The Grid development in Downtown Mesa is moving forward after facing construction-related delays. No official address or opening timeline has been announced. Avondale and Surprise are also now under consideration for future expansion.

Avondale is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location, according to a Phoenix Business Journal report. No address, timeline, or confirmed plans have been announced.

Surprise is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location, according to a Phoenix Business Journal report. No address, timeline, or confirmed plans have been announced.

L&L Hawaiian Barbecue opened a new location on May 11 at La Costa Town Square in Carlsbad, marking the brand's 100th location in California. The location is franchised by Chloe Tran and offers dine-in, takeout, mobile ordering, third-party delivery, and catering. Menu highlights include the Hawaiian Plate Lunch, Chicken Katsu, and Loco Moco.

data.location: 9325 JW Clay Blvd, Suite 211, Charlotte, NC 28262
data.short_description: A new Palm Berries franchise location is preparing to open near Charlotte's university area. The health-focused concept offers acai bowls, smoothies, and fresh-cut fruit, and will mark the franchise owner's third Palm Berries location. Further opening details are expected to be announced closer to launch.

data.location: 606 Broadway E., Seattle, WA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Bait Shop, a Capitol Hill bar operating since 2012, is being forced to relocate as its building is slated for demolition and redevelopment. No new address or timeline has been confirmed, though co-owner Mike Leifur hopes the bar will remain on Capitol Hill. The lack of a firm departure timeline from the landlord has made planning difficult.

Franchisees Jeff and Becky Montie, along with Robbin and Jimmy McCullen, are expanding Palm Berries across North Carolina. The first confirmed location at Quail Corners in south Charlotte is targeting a mid-June opening.

data.location: 16631 Lancaster Highway, Ballantyne, Charlotte, NC (zip not specified)
data.status: We hope to open this unit by late summer
data.short_description: A second Palm Berries location under the same franchise group is planned for Ballantyne at 16631 Lancaster Highway. The franchisees hope to open by late summer 2026.
A third Palm Berries location is in the works for Winston-Salem, with the team nearing a signed lease agreement. No address or opening date has been confirmed.

James Beard Award winners Jody Williams and Rita Sodi are opening a second Bar Pisellino location inside the Flatiron Building. Construction is set to begin in summer 2026, with the restaurant expected to open in 2027. The original location on Grove Street is an all-day café offering light fare, a full coffee program, and a full bar.

Wagyu House is preparing to open its first Arizona location at Chandler Fashion Center, occupying the former Kona Grill space. The all-you-can-eat yakiniku concept specializes in premium Wagyu beef and currently operates in Atlanta and Chicago. An exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 20409 State Hwy 46 W, Suite 108, Bulverde, TX 78163
data.short_description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is expanding in the Spring Branch area of Comal County with a new 1,382-square-foot location. Construction is expected to begin May 15, 2026, with completion anticipated by September 1, 2026. The franchise owner is Farhan Hyder.

Carbonara, an Italian restaurant with an existing Arlington location, is opening a second location in Gainesville in the former Bar Louie space. Owner Chef Mike Cordero anticipates being customer-ready in July, with the new space accommodating around 250 customers.

Miami-born Cuban bakery and cafe Pinecrest Bakery is planning a Miami Lakes location, listed as "coming soon" on its website. The brand has more than 30 locations throughout South Florida and is known for its 24-hour operations and Cuban-American menu.

data.location: 33 Town Square Blvd., Suite 130, Asheville, NC (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Palm Berries is preparing to open two new corporate-owned locations in North Carolina. The Asheville location at 33 Town Square Blvd. is expected to open May 30, with co-founder Chandler Gottlieb citing broader statewide expansion ambitions.

data.location: 7808 Rea Rd., Suite E, Charlotte, NC (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Palm Berries' second upcoming location is planned for 7808 Rea Rd. in South Charlotte, targeting a June 6 debut. The company is focused on operational efficiency and consistency as it scales across North Carolina.

data.location: 3220 W. Bell Rd, Phoenix, AZ (zip not specified) — current food truck location; permanent location not yet identified
data.short_description: Bikini Q BBQ, currently operating as a food truck at 3220 W. Bell Rd. in Phoenix, is targeting an early 2027 opening for its first brick-and-mortar restaurant. Founder Veronica Hansen says the long-term vision centers on a drive-thru model, though a permanent location has not yet been identified.

data.status: hoping we will be open within the first week of June
data.short_description: Bollywood Masala is relocating from its La Plata location at 120 Rosewick Road to a new storefront at 3804 Crain Highway in Waldorf. Owners Rajat and Punita Malhotra are expanding the menu with new specials and cocktails and are nearly done with inspections.

data.location: 3300 N University Dr, Coral Springs, FL 33065
data.short_description: Pilar Coffee Bar has filed permit applications to open a location at 3300 University Drive in Coral Springs, with no opening date yet announced. The South Florida-based boutique coffee shop and bistro plans to open 11 new franchised locations by the end of 2027.

The Boston Licensing Board approved plans for restaurateurs Steve Bisson and Jack Sullivan to open a Garden of Eden-inspired restaurant and cocktail bar called Seven at 545 Washington St, the current home of French Quarter. The 90-seat venue will feature a seven deadly sins cocktail program and an immersive themed atmosphere; a timeline for the transition has not yet been announced.

data.status: hoping to introduce his second restaurant on June 20
data.short_description: Sassy Mac Boys is working on a second location at CherryVale Mall in Rockford, following its brick-and-mortar debut in Machesney Park. Owner Donald Czyzyk is targeting a June 20 opening and plans to expand with a franchise model throughout Illinois.

data.status: set to open before the summer's end / on track to begin greeting guests in early August
data.short_description: Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux is under construction at 2809 E. Highland Drive in Jonesboro, in the former Ryan's Buffet site. Franchisee Chris McJunkins says the 6,500-square-foot newer prototype location is on track to open in early August.

data.location: 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE, Suite 100, Atlanta, GA 30303
data.short_description: Urban Tea Party, a local loose leaf tea brand helmed by Sherolyn Sellers, is opening a pop-up at Studio House Atlanta at 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE, Suite 100. The duration of the pop-up is unclear, though there is potential for a longer residency beyond the summer.

data.status: expected to open in late summer
data.short_description: Bayt Al Mocha, a Michigan-based Yemeni coffee franchise, will open its first California location at 6306 Garfield Avenue, Unit 250, inside the Greenback Corners shopping center. The roughly 1,500-square-foot café will offer traditional Yemeni coffee and pastries and will include a patio area.

data.location: 45 Auto Center Dr, Foothill Ranch, CA 92610
data.short_description: Elio California may be preparing to open a new coffee shop at 45 Auto Center Drive in Foothill Ranch, based on a plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency and a teaser on Instagram. No opening timeline or specific details about the concept have been disclosed.

data.location: 357 Sam Ridley Pkwy W, Smyrna, TN 37167
data.short_description: Dave's Hot Chicken is planning a new restaurant at 357 Sam Ridley Parkway West in Smyrna, led by franchisees Jason and John Hotchkiss as part of a broader Middle Tennessee expansion. Further details and a projected debut timeline have not yet been announced.

Firehouse Subs announced a multi-unit franchise agreement with local entrepreneur William Ellis to open new locations across San Antonio. The first location under the agreement is expected to open in summer 2026 at 1375 S Main St in Boerne.

data.status: expecting to open the location in the fall
data.short_description: Marseille-inspired restaurant Massilia is opening a new Santa Monica location at 2820-2826 Main St., expected in the fall. The restaurant previously had a Santa Monica location on Fourth Street that shuttered at the end of 2025, and recently added a Downtown LA location at The Grand LA.

The Scoop N Scootery is set to make its South Carolina debut at 2414 Devine St. in Columbia, led by franchise owner Emmett Morrison. The location will differ from the brand's traditional model by offering both indoor and outdoor seating, targeting an August opening.

Puff Coffee is preparing to open its second Portland location at 3356 SE Belmont St this summer, taking over a space historically associated with Stumptown Coffee Roasters. The café is expected to open in July, continuing Puff Coffee founder Duane Sorenson's expansion efforts.

data.status: preparing to open later this year / later this summer
data.short_description: Texas de Brazil is preparing to open a location at The Orchard Town Center at 14644 Orchard Parkway, Suite 1200 in Westminster, Colorado. The family-owned Brazilian churrascaria, founded in 1998, operates over 55 restaurants across 23 states.

data.location: 1200 El Paseo de Saratoga, San Jose, CA 95129
data.short_description: Sweetgreen is opening a new 2,406 sq. ft. Saratoga + Campbell location in West San Jose on May 19, 2026. The restaurant will serve signature salads, warm bowls, and protein plates using produce sourced from California farms. Preview events with complimentary meals were scheduled for May 15 and 16.

data.location: 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B, Los Angeles, CA 90068
data.short_description: Pita & Pie has filed an ABC license permit for a new restaurant in the Hollywood area. Little information is known about the concept, including no website or social media presence. Amer Nackoud is behind the concept per the ABC permit filing.

Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is opening a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse in Bastrop at a space that formerly housed Stem & Stone. The restaurant, helmed by owner Robinson Figueiredo, will serve authentic churrasco and Brazilian dishes. The brand announced hiring for the new location and posted a "coming soon" update on social media.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease for a third Metro Detroit location in Roseville. Owner Evan Shina does not currently have an opening date. The Mexican seafood concept already operates locations in Detroit and White Lake.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location on May 31, 2026, with its Spring Valley location remaining open. Owner Kerry Pauly cited a desire to refocus on the original Spring Valley location and the challenges of operating two restaurants. The closure announcement was shared on Instagram and Facebook.

data.status: plans pointing to a later 2026 opening
data.short_description: Jaggers, the burger-and-shake chain operated by Texas Roadhouse, is preparing to open in the former Twin Peaks space near Hanes Mall Boulevard in Winston-Salem. The opening adds to the chain's growing North Carolina presence, which includes existing locations in Fayetteville, Greenville, and Jacksonville. Additional NC locations are also planned for Concord and Raleigh.

Ike's Café & Grill opened its newest location in Marietta with a ribbon-cutting, open house, and community celebration on May 8, 2026. The 3,200 sq. ft. full-service restaurant serves African-inspired cuisine including jollof rice, suya, egusi soup, and grilled meats. The new location evolved from the brand's ghost kitchen concept launched in 2025.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy, announced its closure on social media on May 13, 2026, after five years in business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited economic struggles and the extreme overhead of running a small business as reasons for the closure. The shop was known for East Coast-style sandwiches and in-house prepared meats.

Esther Rum, a women-owned premium spirits brand, has launched in select locations across Columbus, Ohio. The Colombian-imported rum is bottled locally at Echo Spirits in Columbus and was co-founded by Margaret Kerr-Jarrett and Emunah Winer. The brand aims to reposition rum as a sippable spirit comparable to tequila.

Ted's Hot Dogs will open its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026, featuring a retro-inspired design and the brand's first drive-thru. The two-day grand opening celebration includes giveaways, a Golden Keychain for the first customer, free T-shirts for the first 20 customers, and free hot dogs for the first 100 patrons. Founded in Buffalo, New York, in 1927, the fourth-generation chain is known for charcoal-grilled hot dogs and open-fire cooking.

data.location: 100 Corte Madera Town Center, Corte Madera, CA 94925
data.short_description: Vietnamese fast-casual chain Asian Box is set to open at Corte Madera Town Center this fall, per the brand's Instagram. Founded in 2011, the California-based chain offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food made with fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients. Popular menu items include The Workout bowl and Chef Gracie's Grandma's Pho.

Ristobar, a 22-year-old Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, is closing on May 25, 2026 (Memorial Day). The team shared the closure on social media, noting the Chestnut Street space will continue in a new direction through a partnership with Eria Events as an indoor-outdoor events venue called Eria Marina. No specific reason for the closure was shared by the restaurant team.

Sushi Kobashi is an upcoming high-end omakase restaurant coming to Chelsea, led by chef Gang Lin, formerly of Michelin Star-winning Yoshino. The eight-seat restaurant will offer both à la carte options and an omakase experience starting at $250 per guest, with Chinese ingredients incorporated in a nod to Lin's heritage. An opening date has not been announced.

The team behind gastropubs Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social is planning a new concept called Clarke & Moore Kitchen and Bar in Chelsea. The restaurant will offer elevated pub food with 49-person first-floor seating and a second-floor private event space for 74 guests. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 4400 Post Oak Park Dr (4400 Post Oak Hwy), Houston, TX 77027
data.short_description: Mack Allen's is a new 16,000 sq. ft. fine-dining restaurant debuting as an anchor tenant at the 5POP tower in the River Oaks/Uptown area, set to open in July 2026. The restaurant will feature a main dining room, three private dining spaces, and a botanical garden-inspired patio. The menu will focus on New American cuisine including prime beef, wagyu, seafood, and oysters.

Lou Malnati's South Loop location has completed an approximately 2,400 sq. ft. expansion, bringing the restaurant to nearly 8,400+ sq. ft. total. The updated space includes a new full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space accommodating up to 50 guests. The expansion was completed while the restaurant continued regular operations.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar opened its second location on May 15, 2026, inside the Element Hotel by Westin at Campus 244 in Dunwoody. After five successful years in Peachtree Corners, the restaurant brings its globally inspired fusion menu to one of metro Atlanta's fastest-growing mixed-use destinations. The restaurant is co-owned by Charlie Sunyapong, Raquel Stalcup, Natalie Yeung, and Tola Mak.

data.status: targeting a late-summer or early-fall opening
data.short_description: Churp is a new fast-casual concept from Tyler Helikson, the founder behind Happy + Hale, planned to open at Olde Raleigh Village. The concept centers on customizable healthy bowls and will also feature a dedicated kids' bento box-style menu. An exact opening date and full menu details have not yet been announced.

data.location: Address not specified (operates near 87th Street and Cottage Grove, Chicago, IL)
data.short_description: Gig's Gourmet Baked Potato is a food truck and catering operation on Chicago's South Side, specializing in gourmet loaded baked potatoes, comfort food, and signature desserts. Chef Gig McFadden launched the concept after nearly twenty years in high-end kitchens, operating Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. The long-term vision includes expanding beyond a single truck with potential investor partnership.

data.location: 3316 SE Federal Highway, Suite A, Stuart, FL 34997
data.status: No official opening date has been announced
data.short_description: C.R. Chicks has filed permit applications to open a new location at Wedgewood Commons Shopping Center in Stuart, Florida. The Florida-born rotisserie chicken chain, founded in 1992, is also planning a Boynton Beach location expected to open Fall 2026. No official opening date for the Stuart location has been announced.

CAVA is opening a new location in Downingtown serving its signature customizable Mediterranean-inspired bowls, pitas, dips, and proteins. The restaurant will be open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. In conjunction with the opening, CAVA is raising funds for Meals on Wheels-Chester County, matching donations up to $1,000.

Electric Wines, a wine shop and tasting lounge led by former Addison wine director Victoria O'Bryan, is planning to open at 4644 30th Street in University Heights following a liquor license application submission. An exact opening timeline has not been set as the project is still awaiting approvals. The concept will offer a curated wine program with around 200 wines, tasting events, and educational programming.

Newby's, a Memphis bar and restaurant at 539 S Highland Street, is preparing to reopen under new owner Sam Stalnaker, who plans to evolve it into a restaurant-by-day, sports-bar-by-night concept with live music. As of May 20, the space has received a certificate of occupancy from the Memphis and Shelby County Division of Planning and Development. Stalnaker is hopeful the venue may reopen by mid-June, though no official opening date has been set.

data.location: 235 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5H 0A7, Canada
data.short_description: Mizunara, a Japanese whisky bar and cocktail lounge led by owners Michael Liu and Jessica Huang, is set to open in Toronto's Entertainment District at 235 Adelaide Street West. The venue will feature three distinct areas, a cocktail omakase format, and a food program led by executive chef Alyssa Figueira. The bar is named after the mizunara oak used in whisky aging and plans collaborations with Suntory, Nikka Whisky, and the LCBO.
